title: Quenched, Resinous Greek Peas Bowl
description: A unique combination of split peas, Mediterranean flavors, and a tangy miso glaze, all in a meal-prep friendly bowl. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat 1 tbsp of olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the split peas, tomato paste, lemon juice, apple cider vinegar, miso paste, and honey to the saucepan. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the peas are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Meanwhile, cook the feta cheese in a small pan over low heat, stirring constantly, until crumbly and lightly browned. Set aside.
To assemble the bowls, divide the cooked split peas among four bowls. Top with crumbled feta cheese, chopped fresh parsley, and a drizzle of the remaining sauce.
